newly_formalized.why: Make successor identity, authority, bounded succession and recoverable parent preservation explicit. Scale does not guarantee maturity.
Separate candidate optimization from trusted measurement and promotion; evaluator gaming remains a central unresolved risk.
Screen ideas cheaply while requiring actual target-scale replication before promotion.
Compose finite host compute envelopes per generation without permanent label-to-K mapping or private reasoning disclosure.
Require provenance-bearing evidence, bounded revision and explicit unresolved termination; distinguish correction from training/modification/RSI.
Prevent streaming capacity or aggregate corpus size from being presented as demonstrated retention; preserve the 32-byte Stage-A limitation.
Lower NLL and whitespace argmax do not establish useful generation or probability collapse; examine probabilities and hard regression/security gates separately.
